info.title: TVC Partner Calendar API
info.summary: Read-only access to Tamarind Valley Collective's accommodation calendar (phase 1).
info.description:
Lets an approved partner (Linger) see which TVC units it may sell and whether each is free on a given night, before promising a stay to a guest.

**Phase 1 is read-only.** Holds, bookings, guest details, payment and settlement arrive in later phases and will be added to this file as new endpoints within `v1`. Clients must ignore response fields they do not recognise.

## Authentication
Every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys look like `tvcp_` followed by 43 URL-safe characters, are issued by TVC to a named person at the partner, and are shown once. A missing, malformed, unknown, expired or revoked key all return the same `401`. Call the API from your server only; never from a browser or mobile app.

## Dates
All dates are calendar dates (`YYYY-MM-DD`) in India time. A stay is a start date plus a number of nights, so the end date of a window is **not** included: `from=2026-12-12&to=2026-12-15` covers the nights of 12, 13 and 14 December.

## What the API never tells you
Why a night is unavailable, who holds it, who owns a unit, and anything about guests.

## Limits
Up to 60 requests a minute per key, windows of at most 90 nights, dates no more than 365 days ahead. Treat `429` as authoritative and back off for `Retry-After` seconds. Limits may change with at least 30 days' notice.

## Versioning
Additive changes (new fields, new optional parameters, new endpoints) stay in `v1`. A breaking change gets a new version with at least 30 days of overlap and `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers on the old one.

## Environments
Production is live. A sandbox with fake data is planned for phase 2 (see `servers`); until then phase 1 can be tested on production with a read-only key because it carries no personal data.

servers.description: Sandbox (planned for phase 2; not available yet). Fake data, test payments, no real messages. Sandbox keys do not work in production and vice versa.

get.summary: List the units and pools this key may sell
get.description:
Returns only what TVC has granted to this partner; a new key sees an empty catalogue until grants are made. Units granted individually appear in `units`. A pool (a group of interchangeable units, such as TVC's tents) appears in `pools` with its size and capacity range, and its member units are not listed separately: a pool is sold by quantity and TVC assigns the physical unit. Inactive units and pools are left out.

Any method other than `GET` returns `405` with `Allow: GET`.

get.summary: Per-night availability for the granted units and pools
get.description:
For every granted unit, reports each night in the window as `free` or `unavailable`. For every granted pool, reports how many of its units are free that night out of its total. A night is `unavailable` for any reason (a booking, an event, a closure of the unit or the whole farm); the reason is never disclosed.

The window must be real dates, at most 90 nights, start today (India time) or later, and end within 365 days of today. Anything else returns `422 invalid_window`.

Any method other than `GET` returns `405` with `Allow: GET`.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: First night of the window, inclusive.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the window, exclusive: the night of this date is not included. Must be after `from`.

422.description: The window is not acceptable. `error.message` says which rule was broken.

error.message: from cannot be in the past

bearerAuth.description: A partner API key issued by TVC. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

Unauthorized.description: The key is missing, malformed, unknown, expired or revoked. The response is identical in every case. Repeated failed attempts from one address are also limited and return `429`.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests (60 a minute per key), or too many failed key attempts from one address. Wait `Retry-After` seconds.

UpstreamError.description: The calendar is temporarily unavailable. Retry with backoff. The body never contains technical detail.

error.message: The calendar is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable. Branch on this, not on `message`.

id.description: Stable identifier. Use this in later phases to hold or book the unit.

group.description: Optional display grouping, such as a hut name. Not an ownership or type signal.

size.description: Number of active units in the pool.

capacity.description: Smallest and largest guest capacity among the pool's units; the physical unit TVC assigns may be any of them.

NightStatus.description: `free` means the whole night can be sold. `unavailable` means it cannot, for a reason that is not disclosed.

id.description: A unit id from the catalogue.

nights.description: One entry for each night of the window, keyed by date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

free.description: Units in the pool that are free that night.

id.description: A pool id from the catalogue.

generatedAt.description: When TVC computed this answer. Treat availability as a snapshot: a hold (phase 2) is what secures a unit.
